claim_assessments.statement: Confirmed requestedScope and continuationScope have stable identity; a material mutation must derive a successor Contract. The v0.2.0 source and scoped test definitions describe this without proving all download adapters honor it.
claim_assessments.negative: Same contract identity changes scope or budget change silently grants additional URLs.
needed: Execute native scope mutation/successor negative and confirm CLI/runtime consumers do not bypass it
Re-pin v0.2.1/v0.2.2 actual Product scope before reuse as current production fact

claim_assessments.statement: contract.ts has finite ExplorationPermission enumerants NONE/COLLECTION_MEMBER_EDGES/DECLARED_CONTINUATION_EDGES; arbitrary crawler frontier not an admitted permission primitive. Not sufficient to prove all HTTP/discovery engines enforce the boundary.
claim_assessments.negative: Provider page supplies unrelated next URL and acquisition engine traverses it without confirmed continuation.
needed: Run provider adapter negative and multiple-page redirect scope tests on exact HEAD

claim_assessments.statement: ResultPolicy requires multidimensional result and separate transfer/content validation outcome; contract-scope.test.ts does not establish successful bytes, validation, organization or copyright permission. Product forbids synthetic COMPLETED.
claim_assessments.negative: Transfer 200/bytes fetched becomes COMPLETED despite bad media, failed organization, or no rights/source validation.
needed: Find actual ResultPolicy/outcome tests and physical file receipts
Run native content verification/cancel/replay negative and rights policy Owner review
